description: What actually matters on Romanian TV today: World Cup / Euro / Champions League matches, finals, knockout games, national-team fixtures. Detected from real EPG text (titles + descriptions) with quoted evidence — the EPG has no structured event metadata, so detection is keyword-based and honest about it. Each event carries live_status (live / replay / unknown) with the evidence it was derived from; unknown means the EPG does not say whether the broadcast is live. Use this FIRST for questions like "what's important to watch today?".

date.description: Day to scan, YYYY-MM-DD in Europe/Bucharest. Default: today.

limit.description: Max number of events to return

min_tier.description: 1 = only major events (World Cup, Euro, Champions League, finals); 2 = also notable ones (national-team matches, knockout games)

name: tv_important_today
title: Today's important broadcasts (major events)
